description:
Ship the first real release of the pkix crate family: pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, and pkix-chain-simple.

v0.1 scope (from CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md):
- RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA-256 and ECDSA-P-256-SHA-256 signature verification
- RFC 5280 §6.1 path validation: signatures, validity periods, BasicConstraints, KeyUsage, pathLenConstraint, critical extension guard
- No NameConstraints, no PolicyConstraints, no revocation (documented limitations)
- PKITS happy-path subset green (§4.1, §4.2, §4.6, §4.7)
- All four crates published to crates.io as 0.2.0 (0.1.0 was namespace-grab; yank it)

Sub-epics:
- PKIX-cfh: Fix API shape before any implementation (P0, blocks all others)
- PKIX-lwr: pkix-path RFC 5280 §6.1 core validator (P1)
- PKIX-ehn: pkix-path RustCrypto signature backends (P1)
- PKIX-qkl: PKITS integration test suite (P1, needs lwr + ehn)
- PKIX-ahk: pkix-revocation error type + CRL/OCSP (P2, can trail v0.1)
- PKIX-868: pkix-chain-simple full implementation (P2, needs lwr + ehn)

Acceptance criteria for release:
  cargo test --workspace passes
  cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
  cargo +1.73 check --workspace passes (MSRV)
  RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs -D warnings' cargo +nightly doc --no-deps --all-features --workspace passes
  PKITS §4.1, §4.2, §4.6, §4.7 all green
  0.1.0 yanked on crates.io, 0.2.0 published
title: Epic: pkix v0.1 release
